free_tier.stated: Standard plan, free to use for everyone: 2000 directions a day (40 a minute), 3000 geocoding requests a day (100 a minute), 500 matrix requests a day (40 a minute), 500 isochrones a day (20 a minute), 2000 elevation and 2000 snap requests a day, 500 optimization and 500 POI requests a day
free_tier.notes: the daily window resets 24 hours after the first request; the Collaborative plan, for humanitarian, academic, governmental or not-for-profit organisations applying with an organisation email, raises directions to 10000 and geocoding to 15000 a day

per_object_cap.stated: a matrix request takes up to 3.500 locations (origins x destinations, e.g. 50 x 50); a route up to 50 waypoints; a snap request up to 5.000 locations
per_object_cap.notes: read from the Wayback Machine copy of 2026-08-29; the live page answered HTTP 404 on 2026-10-31. The page writes thousands with a dot: 3.500 is three thousand five hundred

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in requests, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS to api.openrouteservice.org (directions, matrix, isochrones, geocode, elevation, optimization, POIs) with a personal HeiGIT API key; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401 'Authorization field missing'; over the daily limit the API answers 403 and over the minutely limit 429, with x-ratelimit-remaining and x-ratelimit-reset headers
tooling: any HTTP client; the interactive API documentation was offline on 2026-10-31 while the API answered
chaining: 3000 geocodes and 2000 routes a day on one personal key; the bulk path for routing is the matrix endpoint (up to 3.500 origin-destination pairs a request, 500 a day); there is no batch geocoding endpoint. Last resort: the user installs and runs the openrouteservice backend, Pelias and VROOM on a rented or free machine with no quota, built from the OSM planet file

limits.value: 3000 geocoding requests and 2000 directions a day on the Standard plan
100 geocoding and 40 directions requests a minute, a sliding 60-second window
3.500 matrix locations (origins x destinations, e.g. 50 x 50) a request; 50 route waypoints

binding_note: the per-minute rates allow more than the daily counts within the day, so the daily quota is met first

identity_cost.detail: a HeiGIT account with first and last name, use cases, an email and a password and an Altcha 'I'm not a robot' check, or GitHub sign-in; one account and one free key per person, and multiple accounts by one user are removed; no card

reliability_note: repeatedly exceeding the limits blocks access temporarily and can disable or remove the account; the openrouteservice.org website and its interactive docs were unavailable on 2026-10-31 while the API stayed reachable
confidence_note: the HeiGIT plans page, terms, sign-up page and API landing page, the openrouteservice FAQ and the Wayback copy of the restrictions page were quoted on 2026-10-31; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401 and the live restrictions page HTTP 404. No account was opened, so no keyed request was made; one would move it to measured.
